objective: Make bootstrap entry and provisional rearm durably distinguishable, classify observed invocations with no startup acknowledgement, and identify the smallest executable independent-wake follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: STARTUP-006 raw invocation is preserved while missing bootstrap/progress boundaries remain unknown.
BOOT_STARTED and REARM_VERIFIED have durable forward-only semantics.
STARTUP_ACK_MISSING is a distinct recovery class with a bounded acknowledgement deadline and no duplicate-authority permission.
Focused tests detect missing bootstrap acknowledgement without treating observability as actual recovery.
A concrete independent-wake implementation slice is selected or its platform dependency is durably identified.
checkpointable_substeps: Reconcile STARTUP-006 and claim epoch 68 after provisional rearm.
Extend successor-start ledger/policy with BOOT_STARTED and REARM_VERIFIED.
Implement focused startup-ack audit tests and CI integration.
Inspect existing event-wake candidate and package the smallest executable recovery transport step.
handoff_boundary: STARTUP-006 reconciled; bootstrap-stage observability implementation begins.
early_finish_fallback: Audit state/WAKE_ARCHITECTURE and event-wake candidate for an actually executable same-canonical wake path; do not mistake detection for recovery.
